name: The Portman Ritz-Carlton, Shanghai
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel with contemporary Chinese decor in a shopping, dining and entertainment complex on West Nanjing Road
best_for: Travelers who want a central West Nanjing Road base near a metro station
Families interested in the Ritz Kids programme

facts.text: The hotel is at Shanghai Centre, 1376 Nanjing West Road, Shanghai.
The hotel is in a retail, dining and entertainment complex on West Nanjing Road.
Guest rooms and suites have city views and contemporary Chinese decor.
Rooms have Chinese artwork, onyx panels and fresh flowers.
Portman's Restaurant has warm lighting and semi-private booths and serves international dishes.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools.
The gymnasium offers aerobics and Pilates classes and squash.
The fitness center is complimentary to registered in-house guests.
Jing'an Temple Subway Station is listed as nearby.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times a day.
The Two-Bedroom Penthouse Suite is on the 45th floor at the top of the hotel.

highlights.text: Public spaces are done in Spanish sandstone and marble, with silver leaves on the walls and Chinese lanterns.
The Ritz Bar & Lounge reimagines the glamour of 1920s Shanghai.
Every Wednesday, Club Lounge members are invited to a cocktail crafting class with the head mixologist.
Children find a tent pitched in their room on arrival as part of Ritz Kids Night Safari Adventures.
Seasonal Ritz Kids activities include a scavenger hunt, Little Hotelier and cupcake making.

considerations.text: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is the closest airport, about 14 km from the hotel, and the hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
